python3 -c "
from more_itertools import unique_in_window, partial_product

# Test unique_in_window
result = list(unique_in_window([0, 1, 0, 2, 3, 0], 3))
print('unique_in_window:', result)
assert result == [0, 1, 2, 3, 0], f'Expected [0, 1, 2, 3, 0], got {result}'

# Test partial_product
result = list(partial_product('AB', 'C', 'DEF'))
print('partial_product:', result)
expected = [('A', 'C', 'D'), ('B', 'C', 'D'), ('B', 'C', 'E'), ('B', 'C', 'F')]
assert result == expected, f'Expected {expected}, got {result}'

# Also test the ones/tens/hundreds example from docstring
result2 = list(partial_product(range(1,4), range(10,60,10), [100,200]))
print('ones/tens/hundreds:', result2)

print('Both tests passed!')
"
